options.name: The Perch
options.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic production-quality desktop website UI concept for BURQUE, a local adult music/comedy/culture event discovery site in New Mexico. Canvas 1440 x 1024, flat screenshot without browser chrome or device. This is a new exploration named Little Sun. The attached bird branding is the primary visual source: off-white negative space, deep ink navy #001b27, warm golden yellow #ffc344, flat confident rounded silhouettes and white crescent-shaped wing cutouts. Interpret its graphic grammar in the interface, not just placing its logo onto a generic template. Mature charming arts/culture tone, no children's app. Hard constraint: NO GRID, NO TILED EVENT CARDS. No photos, no elaborate assets from event submitters, no repeated decorative words, no gradients, no violet/cyan, no orbit or circular navigation. Restrained color, two fonts maximum, body text 14-16px, excellent typography, natural readable event labels, details and purposeful whitespace. Focus on discovering events and opening details; no extraneous feature inventory. Header BURQUE, small bird mark inspired by reference, 'New Mexico, after hours', navigation 'Explore' and 'Saved'. Current date anchor October 20 2026 America/Denver. Use fictional events Fri Oct23 2026 Desert Frequencies at Sister Albuquerque, doors7pm music8pm,$18,21+, psych rock, Mesa Static / The Low Suns; Fri Oct23 The Late Set at Dry Heat Albuquerque9:30pm,$15,21+, seated comedy90min; Sat Oct24 Ink After Dark at Barelas Print Studio6–8pm,$32,21+, materials included beginner friendly. Include rich practical details as space allows. One clear 'Explore event' action and secondary save. A single independent screen, no presentation captions or concept numbering. Concept name The Perch. Organize the page as an asymmetric chronological branching perch: a fine dark navy vertical stem at x250, with three horizontal branches extending at deliberately different heights and lengths across a white page. Each branch supports a beautifully typeset unboxed event entry, date/time at stem, title and short description on branch. Active first event has a small warm-yellow circle behind a restrained navy category silhouette and uses generous space for lineup, venue, price and door information. Other entries are compact but readable, staggered with generous gaps, never a table or grid. A small bird perched at top of stem acts as selected-day marker. Headline upper left 'Good nights, close by.' Quiet date selector 'Fri 23  /  Sat 24  /  Sun 25'. White page dominates. Branches become subtle architectural lines, not a tree illustration taking over the screen. Selected event expanded inline and other events visible below, clear progressive disclosure. Sophisticated editorial, refined humanist sans, content is protagonist.

NOT rectangular cards: full-width sweeping navy/ivory curved cutouts, wing-like tapered right edges, generous whitespace and refined restrained thin rules. First closed fold is thin with '01  The Late Set', Fri23 9:30pm, Comedy, $15, plus icon. Middle active fold is a large ivory organic wing-shaped opening across the navy base, containing black title 'Desert Frequencies', short inviting description, venue/date/time, small lineup and practical details, with yellow pill Explore event. Third closed fold '03  Ink After Dark' at bottom. Dark negative space provides breathing room. Small discrete yellow sun peeking out at far right of active opening, source bird small by wordmark only. No oversized bird illustration. Make accordion mechanics recognizable using plus/minus, active fill, little '2 of 3 tonight' context, while shape is unusually sculptural and reference-led. Horizontal text baselines, accessible high contrast. Crisp sophisticated actual usable UI, not poster art. Do not copy previous generated timeline; this is a fully different structure.
